name: AutoComplete Address Checkout For WooCommerce
author: theme funda

sections.description:
AutoComplete Address Checkout For WooCommerce integrates Google Places API into your WooCommerce checkout to deliver instant address suggestions as customers type. Billing and shipping address fields are auto-filled in one click — reducing cart abandonment, eliminating typos, and improving the overall checkout experience.

Whether you’re running a classic WooCommerce checkout or the new Gutenberg block-based checkout, this plugin works seamlessly with both.

🔗 Documentation | Pro Version | Support

✅ Free Features

  • Google Address Autocomplete — Real-time address suggestions powered by Google Places API
  • Auto-fill Address Fields — Instantly fills street, city, postcode, state, and country
  • Address Line 2 Support — Fills apartment, suite, unit, neighborhood fields automatically
  • Classic & Block Checkout Support — Works with both WooCommerce classic and Gutenberg block checkout
  • Billing & Shipping Autocomplete — Separate autocomplete for both billing and shipping address forms
  • Customizable Address Fields — Choose which fields to show or hide (street number, postcode, locality, state, country)
  • Place Types Support — Filter suggestions by location type (addresses, cities, regions, establishments)
  • Custom Placeholder Text — Set your own search field placeholder text
  • One-Click Installation — Simple setup, no coding required

🔒 Pro Features

  • Country-Specific Address Filtering — Restrict autocomplete suggestions to specific countries (e.g. IN, US, GB, AU)
  • Up to 15 Country Restrictions — Limit results to your target markets
  • Priority Support — Get help directly from the development team

🔗 Upgrade to Pro →

Why Use AutoComplete Address Checkout For WooCommerce?

Slow and error-prone address entry is one of the top reasons customers abandon WooCommerce checkout. This plugin solves that by:

  • Reducing checkout time — Customers find their address in seconds
  • Eliminating typos — Google-verified addresses mean fewer failed deliveries
  • Improving mobile UX — Autocomplete is especially powerful on mobile keyboards
  • Supporting global stores — Works with addresses worldwide

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Enter your Google Maps API key in the settings
  3. The autocomplete search field automatically appears above the address fields at checkout
  4. Customers start typing their address and select from Google’s suggestions
  5. All address fields (street, city, postcode, state, country) are filled instantly

External Services

This plugin connects to the Google Maps JavaScript API to provide address autocomplete functionality.

  • What data is sent: Partial address text typed by the customer is sent to Google servers to retrieve autocomplete suggestions. No personal or payment data is transmitted.
  • When data is sent: Only when a customer begins typing in the address search field at checkout.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly via the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → AutoComplete Address settings
  4. Enter your Google Maps API Key (requires Places API enabled in Google Cloud Console)
  5. Configure your preferred address fields and options
  6. Save settings — autocomplete is now live on your checkout page

Getting a Google API Key:

  1. Go to Google Cloud Console
  2. Create a new project or select an existing one
  3. Enable Maps JavaScript API and Places API
  4. Create an API key under Credentials
  5. Paste the key into the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google API key?

Yes. A valid Google Maps API key with Places API and Maps JavaScript API enabled is required. You can get one free from Google Cloud Console.

Does this work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. The plugin fully supports both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the new Gutenberg block-based checkout introduced in WooCommerce 8.x.

Does autocomplete work for both billing and shipping addresses?

Yes. Separate autocomplete widgets are added for both billing and shipping address fields automatically.

Can I restrict autocomplete to specific countries?

Country-specific address filtering is available in the Pro version. It allows you to restrict suggestions to up to 15 countries by their 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. IN, US, GB).

Does this plugin store any customer data?

No. The plugin does not store or log any customer address data. Only partial address text is sent to Google for autocomplete suggestions.

Is user consent required for GDPR?

The data transmitted is minimal and strictly necessary for checkout functionality. We recommend mentioning the use of Google Maps in your store’s privacy policy as best practice.

What place types are supported?

You can filter results by: address (precise addresses), geocode (all geocoding results), establishment (businesses), (regions) (areas and regions), or (cities) (cities only).

Where can I get support?

Free support is available via the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support at codesmade.com/contact-us.
